niche_match.note: Baseline 2026-09-16. Include is phrase-based on purpose: a bare \btrees?\b would pull nurseries (Fast Growing Trees), Christmas-tree lots, ancestry ads and holiday decor. Exclude strips idioms, tree SALES/planting, ads selling TO tree businesses (leads, software, marketing, franchise), equipment-for-sale posts and crew hiring posts — all common in this vertical and none are homeowner lead-gen. Tightened same day after the first 2,114 ads: chainsaw/pole-saw product ads (VEVOR dropship on Gentle Stone Peak x13), arborist gift/apparel ads (ziteeprints, pawpowpet, madroop), and B2B lead sellers pitching tree companies (theadvert.app, Urgent Home Leads) were passing the include. Whole-ad B2B strip (the final ^[\s\S]*…$ alternative): relevanceFn tests body+title+page name+url, so a match on a B2B page name or B2B-only phrase blanks the entire text. Added after the full 3,539-ad harvest showed tree-business marketing agencies (Smart Leadz, Tree Service Lead Machine, TreeLead Accelerator, Timberline Marketing, Tree Service Marketing Agency), arborist insurance/software/equipment and crew-hiring ads counted as on-niche. Second pass after the top-50 read: Facebook Marketplace listings from individuals (url facebook.com/marketplace/item, incl. CA$ Canadian posts), saw-blade products (EZARC) and a tree-company marketing agency (Windigo Solutions) were filling price-shock slots; stripped whole-ad.
